sampling cost is high because it contains all the one time costs

sample contains :

  • main pattern
  • manual one piece cutting
  • first time stitching and rework
  • designer intervention
  • retail fabric cost
  • sourcing and logistics

also in some cases

  • digital printing cost
  • print development cost by designer

also this sample is 100 percent adjustable in 50 pieces hope you understand …

also you can directly go with production as we make a preproduction sample for free in that anyways
